# Chethan Kumar — AI, Cybersecurity & Software Engineering Portfolio

> Official engineering portfolio of Chethan Kumar B S (GitHub: StratagemVX), Computer Science Engineer at MVJ College of Engineering, Bengaluru. Documents production and academic repositories across AI, NLP, applied cryptography, and full-stack software engineering.

## Public Portfolio Pages

- [Home](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/): Engineering overview, core technical pillars, and interactive cryptography workbench.
- [Engineering Projects (/work)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/work): Featured software systems and architectural case studies.
- [Technical Evidence (/evidence)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/evidence): Capability-to-codebase verification matrix mapped to source repositories.
- [Repository Archive (/archive)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/archive): Searchable index of public and academic software repositories.
- [Academics (/academics)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/academics): Visvesvaraya Technological University (VTU) coursework and academic engineering foundation.
- [Recruiter Brief (/recruiter-brief)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/recruiter-brief): Executive 60-second engineering assessment summary.
- [Contact (/contact)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/contact): Direct engineering inquiry channels.
- [Résumé (/resume)](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/resume): Web-formatted engineering curriculum vitae.

## Machine-Readable Discovery

- [Sitemap](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/sitemap.xml): XML sitemap covering indexable public routes and case studies.
- [AI Catalog](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/ai-catalog.json): Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) JSON manifest of public portfolio endpoints.
- [ARD Well-Known Manifest](https://chethan-kumar-portfolio.vercel.app/.well-known/ard.json): Standard well-known discovery endpoint.
